name: BACH_0247
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (92%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs Benign · Careful review
Invasive risk is 0%, but the 90% conformal set includes Benign [F1] (simulated frozen section).

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 92%, Benign 7%, InSitu 1%, Invasive 0% | Normal lead; 0% invasive |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90% target) | Cannot exclude Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 97% reliability; 56th percentile [F6] | Typical input; unflagged |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (91%–94%) [F5]; Benign 88% | 5/5 Normal; Benign close |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules (two-layered)** (regions 0, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · High score (-0.62) [F2]; 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-0.33) [F3]; 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Duct-confined atypical cells** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Low score (+0.30) [F4]; 12/20 spot check · Weak
- **HoVer-Net nuclei** (regions 3, 7, 8) · context · Area 40.3 µm² (0th percentile) [F7]; immune 7% (91st) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful in deletion test (drop +0.0114 vs random; 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197 excludes 0).
- **Concepts**: Unproven in deletion test (CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); uses unreliable normal_lobules, mitoses, necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- Tissue is Benign (in 90% conformal set; 88% match to Benign contrast BACH_0266).
- Region 8 (risk 0.003, validated invasion 1.03) or 7 (19 neoplastic nuclei) holds focal disease.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 10**: Check tubules and lymphocytes distinguishing Normal from Benign contrast BACH_0266.
2. **Regions 7, 8**: Review where validated invasion peaks (1.03) with 19 neoplastic-labeled nuclei.
3. **Regions 0, 2, 11**: Confirm two-layered lobules, ductal cells, and clear surgical margins [F11].
